settings.interruptHint: Before a planned move is walked, the side of every enemy that can reach the way is asked whether to step in. A piece that steps in stops the move at that point, and a new engagement zone forms there with both. While turns are kept, it is forming until the turn ends. A move into an engagement zone, or one out of a zone the piece stands in, is also put to the side in the zone, which chooses whether to stop it; a piece it stops moves to the centre and joins. A zone nobody can answer for, and every zone while this is off, always stops it.

roomSettings.wipeConfirmTitle: Erase all data in this browser?
roomSettings.wipeConfirmMessage:
The following will be erased and the page reloaded. This cannot be undone.
- Your settings (display, volumes, skins, widget layout and so on)
- The room's automatic saves and recorded replays
- The room this browser starts on
- The pictures for your dice and skins
- Your login to the room server, and what takes you back to the same seat when the page reloads

Reloading takes you out of the current room for now. If you came in through an invite link, it takes you back in: through SkyWay as someone else, your hand and the GM's role staying with your old seat, and on a room server as a guest until you log in again. If you came in from the lobby, you are left outside the room. Through SkyWay or offline, if you are playing alone, anything in the room you have not saved is lost too.
If the app is open in other tabs, close them first.

diceBot.intro:
[Dice bot] Type dice expressions in chat to roll dice.
Input example) 2d6+1 attack!
Output example) 2d6+1 attack!
              diceBot: (2d6) → 7
You can also include a dice expression followed by a space and additional text.

Usage examples
  3D6+1>=9 : Roll 3d6+1 and check whether the total is 9 or more.
  1D100<=50 : D100 downward roll with target value 50.
  3U6[5] : Roll 3d6 with reroll on 5+ (open-ended above).
  3B6 : Roll 3d6 and output values separately (no sum).
  10B6>=4 : Roll 10d6 and count dice with value 4+.
  2R6[>3]>=5 : Reroll dice >3 then count dice with value 5+.
  (8/2)D(4+6)<=(5*3) : Arithmetic is allowed in count/sides/target.
  c(10-4*3/2+2) : c(expression) evaluates math only.
  choice[a,b,c] : Pick one element at random.
  S3d6 : Prefix S for a secret roll (others cannot see).
  3d6/2 : Divide the result (rounding depends on system). Use /2C (ceil), /2R (round), /2F (floor).
  D66 : D66 die. Order depends on the system: D66N (raw), D66A (ascending), D66D (descending).

For full details see the bcdice command guide:
https://docs.bcdice.org/
